scripts.dev:student: cd apps/student-web && PORT=3001 npm run dev
scripts.dev:lecturer: cd apps/lecturer-web && PORT=3002 npm run dev
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:student" "npm run dev:lecturer" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "cd apps/student-web && PORT=3001 npm start" "cd apps/lecturer-web && PORT=3002 npm start" "cd apps/backend && npm start"
